fixes.what: Add Afghan Attan and Takht-e-Khina explicitly to the Mehndi & Sangeet celebration description and the inquiry form's Traditions checklist (e.g., 'Mehndi / Hanabandan / Takht-e-Khina' and 'Attan').
fixes.why: Afghan families are one of the three core audiences; seeing their specific henna night and national wedding dance named alongside Persian and South Asian rituals cements cultural fluency with Afghan elders.

fixes.what: Change the Inquiry form's 'Wedding date' input from type="date" to type="text" with placeholder="Season / year or exact date (e.g., Fall 2027)".
fixes.why: Couples and parents inquiring for full-service multi-day planning often have a target season or venue window rather than a locked calendar date.

fixes.what: Add an optional text field for 'Venue or Bay Area city (if known)' beside the Guest Count field in the inquiry form.
fixes.why: Knowing whether the family is looking at Napa, SF, South Bay, or East Bay helps the planner immediately prepare relevant multi-day venue logistics for the first consultation.

fixes.what: Change the Poster CTA button href="index.html#inquire" to href="#inquire" on index.html, or hide the redundant Poster CTA section on index.html since it sits immediately below the on-page inquiry form.
fixes.why: Clicking 'Begin the conversation' right after scrolling past the inquiry form scrolls the user back up to the exact section they just left.
